policy: Curated copies only, taken from the read-only historical research workspace named by `source_workspace_id`. That workspace's file hashes are re-verified at the end of every build, and a drift fails the build. `source_sha256` is the archived original; `target_sha256` is the curated copy published here. A file whose two hashes differ was altered by curation, and `rules_hit` names the substitution classes responsible.
